items.title: ChatGPT 推出 Apple Messages 插件，可代用戶起草及發送短訊
items.title_en: ChatGPT Launches Apple Messages Plug-in to Draft and Send Texts on Your Behalf
items.summary: ChatGPT 推出 Apple Messages 插件，用戶授權後 AI 可直接代起草及發 SMS，數據本地處理唔上傳伺服器，暫只支援英文。
items.summary_en: ChatGPT's new Apple Messages plug-in lets authorised users have AI draft and send SMS on their behalf, with data processed locally — no server uploads. English only for now.
items.why: AI 助手開始接管溝通渠道，落客服流程前先了解授權範圍及私隱限制。
items.why_en: AI is entering direct-comms channels — understand permission scope and privacy implications before integrating into client service workflows.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態

items.title: 企業市場消長：OpenAI 大幅縮窄與 Anthropic 差距，轉換意願高
items.title_en: Enterprise AI Shift: OpenAI Significantly Closes the Gap on Anthropic, Switching Intent Rises
items.summary: 最新調查顯示 OpenAI 企業用戶增幅大幅跑贏 Anthropic，企業客戶切換 AI 供應商意願升高，市場格局加速洗牌。
items.summary_en: New data shows OpenAI significantly outpacing Anthropic in enterprise user growth, with rising intent to switch AI providers reshaping the competitive landscape.
items.why: 揀 AI 工具前要對比最新訂閱生態，企業切換成本低，合約前宜評估。
items.why_en: Before signing enterprise AI contracts, benchmark ecosystem lock-in — switching costs are low and the landscape is shifting fast.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態

items.title: Claude Opus 4.6 發現越獄漏洞，可被誘導產出違規內容
items.title_en: Claude Opus 4.6 Found Vulnerable to Jailbreaks That Generate Harmful Content
items.summary: TechCrunch 測試發現 Claude Opus 4.6 可被誘導產出違規成人內容，Anthropic 已知情正修復，企業用戶需留意風險。
items.summary_en: TechCrunch testing found Claude Opus 4.6 can be manipulated into generating harmful content. Anthropic is aware and working on a fix — enterprise users should review their safeguards.
items.why: 用 Claude API 開發客戶對外產品先做風險評估，加輸入過濾及人工審核層。
items.why_en: Audit Claude API integrations in client-facing products and add input filtering plus human moderation layers before the fix is confirmed.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態

items.title: 有道辦公 Agent LobsterAI 突破百萬用戶，AI 訂閱收入升兩成
items.title_en: NetEase Youdao's LobsterAI Office Agent Tops 1M Users; AI Subscription Revenue Up 20%+
items.summary: 有道Q2淨收入14.7億元，辦公 Agent「LobsterAI」突破百萬用戶，AI 訂閱銷售額同比升逾20%，商業化明顯提速。
items.summary_en: NetEase Youdao Q2 net revenue hit RMB 1.47B, with its office agent LobsterAI topping 1M users and AI subscription sales up 20%+ year-on-year — clear monetisation acceleration.
items.why: 中國 AI 辦公 Agent 已有真實付費轉化，評估大陸企業競品工具可參考呢個基準。
items.why_en: China's AI office agent market is monetising — benchmark this conversion rate when evaluating China-market competitor tools for clients.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態

items.title: Meta AI 推 Mac 全系統語音操控，整合廣告數據可直接問績效
items.title_en: Meta AI Mac App Launches with System-Wide Voice Control and Direct Ad Performance Queries
items.summary: Meta AI Mac 應用支援全系統語音操控，可直接整合 Instagram、Facebook 廣告數據及 Google Workspace，桌面語音問廣告績效成真。
items.summary_en: Meta AI's Mac app enables system-wide voice control and integrates Instagram/Facebook ad data with Google Workspace — ask about campaign performance by voice without opening Ads Manager.
items.why: 唔打開 Ads Manager 直接語音問廣告表現，慳返跳頁操作時間，即裝試用。
items.why_en: Ask about ad performance by voice without switching apps — download and trial it now to save context-switching time.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: Google 推「首選來源」工具，助出版商抗 AI 搜尋流量流失
items.title_en: Google Launches 'Preferred Source' Feature to Help Publishers Reclaim Traffic Lost to AI Overviews
items.summary: Google 推「首選來源」讓出版商主動申請搜尋優先位，試用期間點擊率升高達兩倍，正面回應 AI Overview 蠶食流量問題。
items.summary_en: Google's new 'Preferred Source' feature lets publishers apply for search priority placement, with click-through rates reportedly doubling in trials — a direct response to AI Overview traffic erosion.
items.why: 管客戶 SEO 或內容策略宜即刻了解申請資格，率先登記取得優勢。
items.why_en: If you manage client SEO or content strategy, check eligibility now and register early to gain first-mover advantage.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: Google AI Max 新增多廣告活動 A/B 測試及一鍵 Performance Planner
items.title_en: Google AI Max Rolls Out Multi-Campaign A/B Testing and One-Click Performance Planner
items.summary: Google AI Max 新增跨多廣告活動同步 A/B 測試功能，配合一鍵 Performance Planner，9月在搜尋廣告全面推出。
items.summary_en: Google AI Max now supports multi-campaign A/B testing alongside a one-click Performance Planner, rolling out broadly in Search Campaigns from September.
items.why: 同時測試多個廣告組合慳大量手動設定，9月前預先熟悉介面，率先拎數。
items.why_en: Test multiple campaign variations simultaneously — get familiar with the interface before the September rollout to be first to generate performance data.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: Meta AI 推廣告分析優化功能，免費版先開放、付費版「Meta One」跟住
items.title_en: Meta AI Launches Ad Optimisation Tools Free First, With 'Meta One' Paid Tier to Follow
items.summary: Meta AI 新增廣告分析與優化功能，免費版即可用，升級付費「Meta One」可獲更深層洞察及個人化廣告建議。
items.summary_en: Meta AI's new ad analysis and optimisation tools are available on the free tier now, with deeper insights and personalised recommendations unlocked via the upcoming 'Meta One' paid subscription.
items.why: 喺 Meta One 推出前熟悉免費功能，等付費版到嗰時有比較基礎先決定升唔升級。
items.why_en: Build a baseline with the free tier now so you have evidence to make an informed upgrade decision when Meta One launches.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: Digiday：AI Agent 廣告缺歸因標準，IAB 正研議行業框架
items.title_en: Digiday: AI Agent Ads Lack Attribution Standards; IAB Working on Industry Framework
items.summary: AI Agent 代替人手採購廣告時，點擊歸因仍無行業標準，IAB 已成立工作組，品牌主難以量度 ROI，業界仍處實驗初期。
items.summary_en: When AI agents buy ads autonomously, click attribution has no industry standard yet. IAB has launched a working group, but ROI measurement remains elusive as the industry is still in early experiments.
items.why: 向客戶 pitch AI Agent 廣告採購方案前，要預先說明量度限制，建立合理期望。
items.why_en: Before pitching AI agent buying to clients, proactively explain measurement limitations to set realistic expectations.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: ChatGPT 推出後三成五新網頁帶 AI 撰寫特徵，原創內容稀缺化
items.title_en: Over 35% of New Web Pages Show AI Authorship Signals Since ChatGPT Launch — Original Content Grows Scarce
items.summary: Pew Research 研究：ChatGPT 推出後逾35%新網頁帶 AI 撰寫特徵，.com 域名比例最高，原創人手內容日趨稀缺。
items.summary_en: Pew Research found over 35% of web pages published since ChatGPT launched show AI authorship signals, with .com domains having the highest share — genuine human content is becoming scarce.
items.why: 品牌原創內容愈來愈罕有，高質量人手寫作已成真實差異化優勢，值得加碼投入。
items.why_en: Authentic human-authored content is increasingly rare — quality original writing is a real differentiator worth investing in.
items.section: 創意生產工具

items.title: AI 水印技術普及，反令人手創作身價升、真實性成行銷賣點
items.title_en: AI Watermarking Goes Mainstream — Human Authorship Commands a Premium as Authenticity Becomes a Selling Point
items.summary: 隨 C2PA 標準普及，AI 生成內容日後自動標記，未標記嘅人手創作被視為更高品質，品牌原創故事重獲溢價空間。
items.summary_en: As C2PA standards spread, AI-generated content will be auto-tagged, making untagged human-authored work command higher quality perception — brand storytelling and authentic UGC are regaining a premium.
items.why: 係時候喺 pitch 中強調品牌故事嘅人手溫度，呢個係 AI 生成內容無法複製嘅。
items.why_en: Start pitching the human warmth of brand storytelling — it's a differentiator AI-generated content structurally cannot replicate.
items.section: 創意生產工具

items.title: The Drum：AI 拉低創意門檻，反令真正突破性概念商業價值更高
items.title_en: The Drum: AI Lowers the Creative Bar, Making Genuinely Breakthrough Ideas More Commercially Valuable
items.summary: 創意評審人撰文指 AI 令「合格創意」氾濫，令真正突破性概念愈加搶眼，品牌應更大膽投入原創。
items.summary_en: A Cannes juror writes that AI has flooded the market with passable-but-forgettable creative — making genuinely breakthrough ideas stand out more and brands should invest more boldly in originality.
items.why: 向客戶呈現創意方案時，強調原創概念嘅稀缺性有助提升報價空間同贏取信任。
items.why_en: Emphasise the scarcity of original ideas when presenting creative concepts — it strengthens your pricing position and builds client trust.
items.section: 創意生產工具

items.title: Omnicom 將逾 400 名 Omni AI 工程師轉外判商，引策略疑問
items.title_en: Omnicom Transfers 400+ Omni AI Platform Engineers to Third-Party Contractor, Raising Strategic Questions
items.summary: Omnicom 將旗下 Omni AI 平台逾468名工程師轉移至外判商 Endava，業界質疑其是否淡化自建 AI 核心能力。
items.summary_en: Omnicom has moved 468+ engineers who built its Omni AI platform to third-party contractor Endava, prompting industry questions about whether it is pulling back from building core AI capabilities in-house.
items.why: 大型傳播集團 AI 戰略動向影響整個生態，代理商宜借此評估自建 vs 外判嘅長期取捨。
items.why_en: Holding-group AI strategy shifts ripple across the ecosystem — use this to benchmark your own in-house vs. outsourced AI build decision.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例

items.title: Campaign Asia：各大平台 AI 廣告能力大比拼——Meta 最全，TikTok 增長最快
items.title_en: Campaign Asia: AI Ad Capabilities Benchmarked Across Platforms — Meta Most Complete, TikTok Fastest-Growing
items.summary: Campaign Asia 比較 Meta、TikTok、Google、OpenAI 四大平台 AI 廣告自動化、創意生成及量度能力，Meta 功能最完整，TikTok AI 創意工具增速最快。
items.summary_en: Campaign Asia benchmarks AI ad capabilities across Meta, TikTok, Google, and OpenAI — Meta has the most complete feature set while TikTok's AI creative tools are growing fastest.
items.why: 制定多平台 AI 廣告策略時，呢個比較可直接入 client deck，亦助預算分配決策。
items.why_en: Use this platform comparison directly in multi-channel AI strategy decks and to support budget allocation decisions for clients.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例

items.title: Adweek：AI 策略報告精美易掩弱思維，CMO 須成「Hybrid CMO」
items.title_en: Adweek: AI-Polished Strategy Decks Can Mask Weak Thinking — The Answer Is Becoming a 'Hybrid CMO'
items.summary: Adweek 分析指 AI 工具令策略文件更精美，卻容易掩蓋邏輯漏洞，CMO 須兼具 AI 效率與人類實戰判斷力方能避雷。
items.summary_en: Adweek warns AI tools make strategy documents look polished, which can obscure weak reasoning — successful CMOs need both AI efficiency and hard-won human business judgment.
items.why: 向 C-suite 呈報 AI 行銷計劃時，邏輯嚴謹程度遠比版面設計重要。
items.why_en: When presenting AI marketing plans to C-suite, rigour of reasoning matters far more than how polished the deck looks.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例

items.title: Butler/Till AI Agent 採購音頻廣告：CPM 降 42%，高價值廣告位比例大升
items.title_en: Butler/Till AI Agent Audio Ad Buying Cuts CPM by 42% and Boosts Premium Inventory Share
items.summary: 廣告代理 Butler/Till 與 iHeartMedia 合作，AI Agent 自動採購音頻廣告，CPM 比人手採購低42%，高價值廣告位比例同時提升。
items.summary_en: Ad agency Butler/Till partnered with iHeartMedia for AI agent-powered audio ad buying, cutting CPM by 42% vs. manual buying while simultaneously increasing premium inventory share.
items.why: CPM 跌42%係真實 proof of concept，可即刻入 pitch deck 向客戶說明 AI 採購嘅 ROI。
items.why_en: A 42% CPM reduction is a proven proof of concept — add it to pitch decks now to make the AI buying ROI case to clients.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例

items.title: 前 Google AI 主席 Jeff Dean：Gemini 早期低估 Coding 需求是教訓
items.title_en: Former Google AI Chief Jeff Dean: Underestimating Coding Demand Was Gemini's Early Lesson
items.summary: Jeff Dean 接受訪問時坦言 Gemini 早期低估 Coding 功能需求，強調聆聽用戶需求比追評分指標更重要。
items.summary_en: In his first public interview since leaving Google, Jeff Dean admits Gemini underestimated user demand for coding capabilities, stressing that listening to users matters more than chasing benchmark scores.
items.why: AI 產品路線圖要從用戶場景出發，呢個教訓對代理 AI 提案設計同樣適用。
items.why_en: AI product roadmaps must start from real user scenarios — this lesson applies equally to how agencies design and pitch AI solutions.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例

items.title: 即試：三條問題用 Meta AI 免費功能快速診斷廣告活動
items.title_en: Try Now: Three Questions to Quickly Diagnose Campaign Health with Meta AI's Free Features
items.summary: Meta AI 廣告分析功能免費啟用，三條問題快速診斷：「哪個受眾 CPL 最低？」「哪組創意 CTR 跌最快？」「預算分配是否最優？」
items.summary_en: Meta AI's ad analysis is free to use now. Three diagnostic questions: 'Which audience has the lowest CPL?', 'Which creative's CTR is dropping fastest?', and 'Is my budget allocation optimal?'
items.why: 唔使升級付費版，免費功能已夠診斷常見廣告問題，幫客戶慳半小時報告時間。
items.why_en: No paid upgrade required — free features are already enough to diagnose routine campaign issues and save clients 30 minutes of reporting time.
items.section: 即學技巧 & 玩法

items.title: 即試：Google AI Max 多活動測試三步設置搜尋廣告 A/B 對照實驗
items.title_en: Try Now: Set Up a Google AI Max Multi-Campaign A/B Test in Three Steps
items.summary: Google AI Max 多廣告活動測試9月全面開放，依入 Ads Manager → Experiments → AI Max Draft 設定，同步比較唔需手動切換。
items.summary_en: Google AI Max multi-campaign testing rolls out in September. Navigate to Ads Manager → Experiments → AI Max Draft to set up simultaneous comparisons without manual switching.
items.why: 提前熟悉介面，等9月開放即係第一批跑出數據，向客戶展示有根有據嘅建議。
items.why_en: Get familiar now so you are among the first to generate data in September and give clients evidence-based recommendations.
items.section: 即學技巧 & 玩法

items.title: 玩法：一篇 Case Study 用 AI 轉出三種格式，統一訊息零重複入稿
items.title_en: How-To: Turn One Case Study Into Three Content Formats with AI — Zero Re-Keying, Consistent Messaging
items.summary: 三步 workflow：① 餵 AI 摘要核心論點；② 要求重寫成30秒短片鏡頭腳本；③ 再縮成三款不同社交平台帖文草稿，全程訊息一致。
items.summary_en: Three-step workflow: ① Feed AI to extract the core argument; ② Rewrite as a 30-second short video script; ③ Condense into three platform-specific social post drafts — consistent messaging throughout.
items.why: 一個素材出三種格式唔需三倍製作費，省番嘅時間落去落廣告同優化。
items.why_en: One content asset, three formats — no triple production cost, leaving more time for placement and optimisation.
items.section: 即學技巧 & 玩法
